sentences.en: She gave me an undisguised look of disappointment.
sentences.zh: 她给了我一个明显的失望的眼神。

sentences.en: The politician's undisguised hatred for the opposition was clear to everyone.
sentences.zh: 这位政客对反对派的明显憎恨让所有人都看得很清楚。

sentences.en: His undisguised admiration for her work won him many admirers.
sentences.zh: 他对他作品的明显钦佩赢得了很多人仰慕他。
